description: A production file's row in testicle.db: {name, hash, deleted, changed}. name is the file, scoped to run://. A file with no rows yet gets its file row and a suite row, flagged needs testing, for every suite that concerns it, as a change would make them. A name that is no production script answers the error "not a production script"; a production script that is not there, "no such file".
